T1_profile_preservation_under_transport.statement: Rainbow Road transport can change relational state and History while preserving a closed projection identity profile.

T2_resolution_dependent_identity_failure.statement: A transport can preserve identity at coarse Resolution and fail the deeper profile match at finer Resolution.

T3_formalism_classifier.statement: No single simpler candidate satisfies all current requirements; a fibered/category-like transport structure over a simplicial/higher-order base is the minimal composite candidate among those tested.
